acceptanceCriteria: A test builds a partial clone where the CEM map is present and a cited blob is missing, calls cem.report, and proves no fetch occurs (no promisor traffic, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH respected) and the result is the specified refusal or degraded report.
body: Found during V1-0349 (batch L, 2026-10-08). Over a partial clone, MCP cem.report refuses with cem-map-unavailable before it reaches any blob, so the end-to-end no-lazy-fetch path for a valid map is untested; only the refusal path is covered.

completion.reason: Delivered in batch P (PR beamfall/corvint#704, merged 2026-10-09 at main dd90cfa6): CEM report valid map for partial clones; independent review PASS first time; focused tests passed; CEM bound and sealed. Limits retained in the build logs.

title: Test the MCP cem.report no-fetch path for a valid CEM map over a partial clone
